answer: Randomized Role Lattice via VRF. Each epoch, a beacon draws roles from a keyed VRF over agent IDs; assignments form a trellis of task lanes, and only drawn agents may act or earn. The seed is revealed only after commitments close, so attackers cannot precompute which identities to spawn. Crossing a canyon of unselected epochs yields zero reward, while flooding identities dilutes selection probability across a widening ocean of keys. Cost: attacker must hold many live agents through unknown future draws, paying full upkeep with near-zero expected yield.
